autopilots.description:
Autonomous charter status transitioner for OMK BOS Nexus Business Area project . Per AMEND-002 §17.3 + USER-DIRECTIVE 2026-07-17 'JAMAIS MOI' (status moves are NOT A0/USER work).

TRANSITION CHAIN per V4 Triptyque structuration + GSD/A3-in-L1 + A2-orchestrates pattern :

1. **A1 Beth (BMad) phase gate** = triage charter between 'todo' and 'in_progress' (Analysis → Planning → Solution)
2. **A1 Morty (Gstack) parallel exec** = advance from 'in_progress' to 'in_review' when work complete
3. **A2 (with /superpowers) manages A3** = validate charter technical completeness
4. **A3 (with /gsd) Daily Scrum** = close 'in_review' → 'done' with result comment
5. **B1 Jerry Prime (orchestrateur des 8 B2 per ADR-CANON-001)** = final gate + B1 Summers (SHIP) = announcement

FUNCTIONS (run on every heartbeat, cron */15 * * * * = every 15 min for low latency) :

a. **D5 verify** :  — scan all 8 sub-issues
b. **D5 detect** : for each issue, identify its current state
c. **D6 auto-transition** rules per the V4 Triptyque structuration order :
   - Charter in  for > 24h with comments → transition to  (work started)
   - Charter in  with last comment from B1 Jerry Prime saying 'review ready' → transition to 
   - Charter in  with no comment for > 4h → flag A0-Amadeus (T2 internal publish)
   - Charter in  with B1 Jerry Prime 'APPROVED' comment → transition to  (T0 routine per ADR-L2-PAPERCLIPAI-004 §1.1, NO anti-paperclip veto)
d. **D4 append-only** : log each transition to wiki/log.md with full provenance
e. **D6 honest ledger** : tally of transitions made this run + cumulative tally

ANTI-PAPERCLIP per ADR-L2-PAPERCLIPAI-004 §1.1 : this autopilot is T0 ROUTINE (sub-agent dispatch, status transition, monitoring) = NO anti-paperclip veto. The agent's only output is 'multica issue update --status <new_state>' which is internal T0/T1 (no T2-T5).

LANE : PPR (réversible). Default model : M3 per ADR-LLM-COST-COMPARE-001 ($0.30/$1.20 per 1M tokens, ~$0.50/month for 15-min heartbeats).

USER-DIRECTIVE 2026-07-17 'JAMAIS MOI' = explicit A0 NON-INVOLVEMENT in status transitions. A0 = Jumeau Numérique Observateur per AMEND-002 §17.4. A0 OBSERVE, not EXECUTE.

Sister canon : ADR-L2-KARDASHEV-TYPE-FRACTAL-001 AMEND-002 §17.3 (A3 in L1 simulates L2 via /gsd) + ADR-L2-PAPERCLIPAI-004 (T0 routine carve-out) + ADR-AAAS-PRICING-001 (AaaS Doctrine) + ADR-CANON-001 §B-Layer Binding (B1 Jerry Prime = orchestrateur des 8 B2).

autopilots.description:
Autonomous watchdog. Per ADR-L2-PAPERCLIPAI-004 §1.1: T0 routine = sub-agent dispatch self-monitoring. NO anti-paperclip veto. LANE PPR. Economics: M3 = $0.30/$1.20 per 1M tokens = ~$1.50/month for 24/7 routine T0.

CONTEXT DISCIPLINE (PPR, autocompact-safe, ASP-116 patch 2026-07-17):
- Hard cap on every log read: `multica daemon logs -n 30` (NEVER unbounded tail).
- NEVER run awk-grep over a full 1h window inline — count markers with bounded reads only.
- NEVER read daemon.log file directly; route all log reads through `multica daemon logs`.
- Hard cap comment history: read only `--recent 3` and only on the current issue id.
- Skip all comment-history reads on parent issues unless the current issue is explicitly blocked on parent context.
- Reuse `context-bloat-detector` skill only if pre-prompt introspection is required; do not load it for routine ticks.

FUNCTIONS (run on every heartbeat, cron */30 * * * * America/New_York):
1. F1 daemon status: `multica daemon status`. If stopped → `multica daemon start` (T0).
2. F2 runtime health: `multica runtime list --output json`. If Hermes/Codex offline > 1h → `multica runtime restart` (T0).
3. F3 BOUNDED ERROR/FAIL scan (replaces prior unbounded tail):
   a. `multica daemon logs -n 30 | grep -cE "ERROR|FAIL"` → distinct marker count.
   b. If count ≥ 3 in last 30 lines → T2 advisory: append single line to wiki/log.md naming the highest-severity marker + flag A0 in issue title (T2).
   c. NEVER cat/awk/grep more than 30 lines in one go.
4. F4 heartbeat: ALWAYS append one line 'Multica Self-Watchdog heartbeat OK' to wiki/log.md (D4 append-only, single line, no full daemon log embedded).

VERIFICATION RECEIPT (mandatory each run, D1 verify-before-assert):
- daemon pid + uptime
- 7/7 runtime count (or named offline runtime)
- F3 bounded count (single integer)
- single-line heartbeat append verification (grep "Multica Self-Watchdog heartbeat OK" wiki/log.md)

ANTI-PAPERCLIP: T0 routine only. No external publish, no charge, no contract, no self-modifying code. Lane PPR. Reversal path: `multica autopilot update b3b2ef13-c1af-4fba-b73e-f82b5d0b0b8c --description "<prior text>"` (prior text recoverable from `multica autopilot get` history or git).
autopilots.title: Multica Self-Watchdog

CONTEXT DISCIPLINE (PPR, autocompact-safe, ASP-116 patch 2026-07-17):

MONITORING:

- Runtime health: re-trigger offline runtimes via F2 short-circuit (offline >1h → restart)

VERIFICATION RECEIPT (mandatory each run, D1):

- single-line gate heartbeat append to wiki/log.md

ANTI-PAPERCLIP VETO (T5 only): MAXIMIZER MODE REFUSED, self-modifying ML REFUSED.

LANE: PPR (réversible). Reversal path: `multica autopilot update 2dabf5b8-dc6a-4629-a866-8c7493652a22 --description "<prior text>"`.
